rules.name: Bot heartbeat stalled or missing
rules.summary: Bot progress is stale or telemetry is unavailable.
rules.description: Progress age >180s or no current marker, pending 2m. Inspect Render and Cloud; do not restart or send orders automatically.

rules.name: No successful trading candle
rules.expr: (time() - max(bot_cycle_success_timestamp_seconds{bot="bybit-shortbot",component="trading-bot",environment="__ENVIRONMENT__"}) > bool 1200) or on() ((time() - max(bot_process_start_timestamp_seconds{bot="bybit-shortbot",component="trading-bot",environment="__ENVIRONMENT__"}) > bool 1500) * on() absent(max((bot_cycle_success_timestamp_seconds{bot="bybit-shortbot",component="trading-bot",environment="__ENVIRONMENT__"} and on(job, instance) (bot_process_start_timestamp_seconds{bot="bybit-shortbot",component="trading-bot",environment="__ENVIRONMENT__"} == on() group_left() max(bot_process_start_timestamp_seconds{bot="bybit-shortbot",component="trading-bot",environment="__ENVIRONMENT__"})))))) or on() vector(0)
rules.description: Success age >20m; if never successful, allow 25m after process start, then 5m pending. Waiting is not candle success.

rules.name: Bybit API errors observed
rules.summary: Existing Bybit SDK calls returned errors.
rules.description: New errors within 15m; inspect operation/category. Do not retry an order manually.

rules.name: Bybit API critical error rate
rules.expr: ((sum(increase(bot_api_errors_total{bot="bybit-shortbot",component="trading-bot",environment="__ENVIRONMENT__"}[15m])) >= bool 5) * on() (sum(increase(bot_api_errors_total{bot="bybit-shortbot",component="trading-bot",environment="__ENVIRONMENT__"}[15m])) / sum(increase(bot_api_requests_total{bot="bybit-shortbot",component="trading-bot",environment="__ENVIRONMENT__"}[15m])) >= bool 0.25)) or on() vector(0)
rules.summary: At least five API errors and >=25% errors over 15m.
rules.description: Read-call retries are counted as existing SDK invocations. No traffic alone is not an API failure.

rules.name: Persistent disk critically low
rules.expr: max((bot_disk_available_bytes{bot="bybit-shortbot",component="trading-bot",environment="__ENVIRONMENT__"} and on(job, instance) (bot_process_start_timestamp_seconds{bot="bybit-shortbot",component="trading-bot",environment="__ENVIRONMENT__"} == on() group_left() max(bot_process_start_timestamp_seconds{bot="bybit-shortbot",component="trading-bot",environment="__ENVIRONMENT__"})))) < bool 104857600
rules.summary: Less than 100 MiB free on DATA_DIR filesystem.
rules.description: Inspect disk usage read-only. Never delete state.json, backups or logs automatically.

rules.name: Telemetry exports failing
rules.summary: At least three failed telemetry exports over 15m.
rules.description: Errors may arrive only after delivery recovers. Missing delivery is covered by the heartbeat rule.

rules.name: Telemetry events dropped
rules.description: Technical counters/latency may undercount. Trading remains fail-open; inspect CPU/RAM and Cloud delivery.

rules.name: Repeated observed process starts
rules.summary: More than two observed start-time changes in 30m.
rules.description: Lower-bound estimate sampled every minute, not a Render restart counter. Do not restart again to test this alert.
